providerSubstitution.seam: The existing scoped ESM loader substitutes only the upstream package's webgpu import; the production LIF simulator, shader, and CPU oracle remain unchanged.

runtimeOwnershipPlan.incumbentLimitation: The recorded upstream cross-vendor probe found different final membrane bytes and did not validate spike masks, leaving the exact live runtime and semantic boundary incomplete.
runtimeOwnershipPlan.applicationConsequence: A green repeatability test can be mistaken for GPU determinism when a fallback ran, or membrane-byte divergence can be overstated without an independent spike oracle.

materialOutcome.metric: live-provider identity, same-backend repeatability, CPU membrane tolerance, exact spike-mask parity, and replay identity
materialOutcome.decisionRule: Promote DoeRuntime only if D0 satisfies a frozen semantic or reproducibility outcome that W0 cannot satisfy; require P0 only if W0 exposes a bounded runtime defect.

I0.construction: Ambient webgpu package without Doe evidence interpretation.

I1.construction: Pinned webgpu@0.3.10 without Doe evidence interpretation.

W0.construction: Pinned webgpu@0.3.10 under the exact provider, oracle, and replay contract.

D0.construction: DoeRuntime under the same provider, oracle, and replay contract.

P0.construction: The smallest bounded incumbent correction, required only if W0 fails a frozen obligation.

fallbackPolicy.providerIdentityAssertion: The selected wrapper, adapter identity, and Vulkan host evidence must bind a physical GPU; mock or software execution is ineligible.

workload.sameWorkPolicy: All lanes execute the same three upstream LIF CPU/GPU twin cases, canonical three-run membrane probe, seed variant, tick variant, shader, synchronization, and readback path.
workload.completionBoundary: Each case completes all tick dispatches, reads membrane and spike buffers, applies the CPU tolerance and exact spike oracle, and destroys its simulator; the process then completes repeatability and nondegeneracy probes.

performancePolicy.timingScope: not admitted for this determinism diagnostic
performancePolicy.throughputMetric: completed LIF oracle cases per process
